blocks.text: Cariboo Hill Secondary (8580 16th Ave) is a secondary school in Cariboo. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.
Cariboo homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Cariboo, September 2026. No detached houses were listed or sold in Cariboo between June and September. Condos and townhomes: 23 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 4% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Condos and townhomes: 7 sold over 4 months against an average of 20.5 listed, about 11.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold.

faq.a: In east Burnaby around Cariboo Road and Cariboo Hill, between Lougheed Highway and the Edmonds side, anchored by Armstrong Elementary and Cariboo Hill Secondary; it is a GVR MLS® sub-area within the City of Burnaby.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Cariboo address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. In-area SD41 schools include Armstrong Elementary (K–7), 8757 Armstrong Ave, Lyndhurst Elementary (K–7), 9847 Lyndhurst St, and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8–12), 8580 16th Ave; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

The City is replacing the Cameron Community Centre and Library — a $267 million project with a library, aquatic facility, two-court gymnasium, weight room, indoor running track and fitness studios — while a temporary centre and library operate inside The City of Lougheed Shopping Centre.

faq.q: Can a Cariboo house lot add units?
faq.a: Under Burnaby's R1 SSMUH District, a house lot may hold 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop, and multi-unit lots may be stratified.
